verdict.rationale: Scale behavior and item caps are a fair question for an issue tracker, but the pack contains no documentation of performance at workspaces with tens of thousands of issues and nothing on per-workspace issue caps or plan limits. Community comments that Linear feels faster than Jira are general impressions and say nothing about behavior at this scale. API rate limits govern request throughput, not the number of items a workspace can hold, so they do not answer this story.
